cases.prompt: Four Proxmox nodes: three 128 GiB in rack A, one 192 GiB in rack B; 280 GiB VM demand and 24 GiB reserve per survivor. It must survive losing any one node and losing rack A. A QDevice can go in rack B.

Count pooled RAM without per-scenario survivors
